parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables/Disables remotely accessing the CPE's user interface.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Destination TCP port required for remote access connection.

parameters.name: SupportedProtocols
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the protocols that are supported by the CPE for the purpose of remotely accessing the user interface.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: This is the protocol currently being used for remote access.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to remotely accessing the CPE's user interface. Remote access is defined as any entity not of a local subnet attempting to connect to the CPE. Remote access requires user authentication. To provide remote access authentication the CPE MUST support a "User" table with at least one instance that has "RemoteAccessCapable" set to {{true}}. {{deprecated|2.16|due to the introduction of {{object|#.HTTPAccess}}}} {{obsoleted|2.18}} {{deleted|2.19}}
